beaches.name: Lageri (Laggeri)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established on the southern part of the beach. A naturist directory carries consistent visitor reports from 2012 to 2024, mostly 90-100% nude at the southern end and dunes; the northern section near the jetty stays in swimwear. A 2023 Greek press listicle also names Lageri; no designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Voutakos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the northern end, beyond the second clump of trees. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2003, 2023 and 2024, the recent ones putting that section at two-thirds to over 90% nude. The bay is sheltered from the north wind; no designation or signage is documented.
